pre_execution_erratum.reason: The v0.1.0 positive-control text required two distinct one-site charges inside every candidate family, but a translation-summed family does not contain position-resolved one-site charges. No frozen-holdout acceptance row had been executed when this defect was found.
pre_execution_erratum.scientific_change: Replace the impossible one-site wording with family-contained explicit independent kernels. Holdouts, sizes, ranges, primes, rank rules, and claim boundaries are unchanged.

frozen_holdouts.required_disjointness: Neither coupling may occur in R193-R195 observed, engineering, or acceptance grids.

exact_acceptance_rule.rank_rule: Every nonzero-coupling row must have rank ncols-2 under both primes.
exact_acceptance_rule.digest_rule: Every accepted sparse commutator matrix must have a canonical SHA-256 digest.

positive_control_rule.required_witness: Each candidate family must contain at least three linearly independent exact kernels: identity, H, and one explicit family-contained extra conserved charge. Complete and boundary-dressed families may use a position-resolved tilted-field charge; the translation-summed family must use the open-chain translation sum of adjacent tilted-field products.

claim_boundary.positive_result_requires: An explicit additional conserved operator or alternate integrable structure.
claim_boundary.negative_result_supports_only: The declared finite-size, finite-range ansatz families have no kernel beyond identity and H.
